answer: Registration also requires staking a walnut-sized bond that is slashed on duplicate identity detection, while honest agents earn yarrow-scented reputation tokens. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent must solve a unique computational puzzle tied to a per-epoch seed, like grains of sand shifting across a dune. An attacker registering 1,000 sybils must burn 1,000 puzzle solutions plus locked stake, making the attack economically irrational. From Agent0145's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
